name: Stuffed roasted chiles
intro: Charred poblanos, stuffed and baked in a simple tomato broth. Picadillo on a weeknight, jack cheese when there's no meat.
season_anchor: Picadillo (ground beef, diced apple, chile), or Monterey jack
season_options: Canned whole tomatoes, blended with a little onion and garlic

variations.context: Picadillo inside, apple slaw on the side.
No meat. Cheese inside, chile strips and lime over the broth.
Picadillo, with escabeche at the table.

finish: For the picadillo, brown the beef hard, then add a little diced onion, one diced apple, a chopped roasted chile, salt, and a splash of the blended tomatoes, and cook until thick. Slit each roasted poblano down one side, pull out the seeds, and stuff it. Spoon the blended tomatoes into a baking dish, set the chiles in it, and bake at 425°F for 15 minutes.
